mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which can impair rilpivirine absorption and increase risk of QT prolongation; rilpivirine is a narrow therapeutic index drug sensitive to pH changes and electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and QT interval closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; supplement electrolytes aggressively; ensure adequate hydration and consider liposomal amphotericin B formulation to reduce nephrotoxicity.
